title: The Fallen Scion
text: A body in good armour lies under a cairn the weather has pulled apart, the stones scattered, the bones still neat inside the plate. The sigil on its shield belongs to no House you know. The seal on the letters in its satchel is still unbroken.

options.label: Bury the stranger properly, as you would want someone to bury you.

outcomes.text: It takes an hour, and nobody minds. While you work the wind stops, as if in respect.

options.label: Take the dead stranger's armour. Good plate should not lie in the rain.

outcomes.text: It fits perfectly, as if made for the one wearing it now. For a while, nobody says anything.

options.label: The wisest breaks the seals and reads the letters, to learn who this was.

outcomes.text: The letters tell of a House that once held this place, what it found here and why nobody remembers it.
